Facilities

Built for horses. Designed for good work.

A quiet professional base south of Liège, close to La Roche-en-Ardenne, for breeding and developing young horses.

Discover Prepinson

Professional facilities, quiet surroundings

  • 18 sport boxes
  • 27 × 60 m indoor arena · fibre
  • 40 × 75 m outdoor arena · ebb & flood
  • 28 ha hectares of land
  • Preparation area, solarium, shower, tack room and horse walker
  • Clubhouse with kitchen and views over both arenas
  • Separate breeding stable with veterinary reproduction equipment
  • Quiet surroundings with direct opportunities for hacking

Between 5 and 15 boxes can be rented for a professional rider.

Availability on request
